title: Fields of The World: Field Boundaries for Belgium
description: Field boundaries and crop classifications for Belgium from the 2021 agricultural campaign, sourced from the Agriculture and Sea Fisheries Agency's annual crop inventory. The dataset documents field geometries, crop types, and previous crop information with a reference date of April 30, 2021.

_readme.text:
## Description

The inventory of the original plots is done annually by the Agriculture and Sea Fisheries Agency in the context of the payment of the (co-financed) European agricultural subsidies and the Flemish manure legislation.

As standard, publishers exchanged plots used for the main crop on the final submission date of the collective application (reference date). For the 2021 campaign this is 04/30/2021.The metadata also provides the date that is being prepared for the 2021 campaign. This is the final condition of the plots on 15/03/2022. The dataset has an informative value for a generalized use and is in no way intended for control purposes or individualized use.

_The field boundaries are valid for the year 2021_

- **Source Data Curator:** [EuroCrops](https://github.com/maja601/EuroCrops/wiki/Belgium)
- **Original Data Provider:** [The Agriculture and Sea Fisheries Agency](https://metadata.vlaanderen.be/srv/dut/catalog.search#/metadata/d869db4a-73f4-470e-b5ca-a0f7cd3ab585)
- **Converted by:** Kerner Lab (ASU)
- **License:** No restrictions on public access
- **Projection:** EPSG:4326
